overview_description.description: Redcliffe Labs is a diagnostics service provider that uses technology to identify communicable and non-communicable diseases by providing radiography and pathology services.  The company provides a thorough portfolio approach with standard and specialized test menus and cutting-edge testing labs. Redcliffe Labs aims to make health tests accessible to all Indians through the use of technology, labs, and a trusted radiology network.
